paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Results of DPR with corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion on the dev set of MS-Marco.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of different DPR models on the MS-Marco dev set, displaying the MRR@10 as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)." It has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and exhibits a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0. A black line, labeled "DPR w/o query," is shown as a solid line with triangular markers; it starts at a value of approximately 34.5 at x=1 and ends around 34.7 at x=10. The blue line, labeled "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion," is a solid line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 34.7 at x=1 and descends to a value of roughly 34.4 at x=6, before increasing to approximately 34.5 at x=10.  The green line, labeled "DPR w/ document expansion," is rendered as a solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 34.6 at x=1, decreases to a value of around 34.4 at x=4, and then rises to approximately 34.6 at x=10. Finally, the red line, labeled "DPR w/ corpus expansion," is a solid line with circular markers, beginning at a value of approximately 35.4 at x=1 and gradually increasing to roughly 35.8 at x=10.
